title: Q-SAYDO-rules-CLAIMS-1: says CLAIMS-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CLAIMS-1
**Status:** closed

The system states `CLAIMS-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation claims --check: DRIFT how-ultrastable-second-order [claim] site/worker.js: json:doctrine/ultrastability.json::patience_ticks==2 failed (doctrine/ultrastability.json: patience_ticks=3); claims: 403 verified of 404; 1 

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CLAIMS-1` exits 0.

**Evidence:** say-do check at 2026-11-25T22:16:27Z: the statement matches its code or is no longer stated.
